summary: Tested Blog + Contact + Admin (blog/messages) feature. Backend: 14/14 pytest passing (public blog list/detail with seeded posts, contact POST, admin contacts list, admin upload+auth, admin blog CRUD, regression /api/products). Frontend public flows fully working (navbar Journal/Contact + Connexion button -> /login, /blog shows 3 seeded cards, /blog/:slug renders content, /contact submits and shows 'Message envoyé' toast). Admin tabs 'Blog' and 'Messages' buttons exist and are clickable, but their content NEVER renders because AdminPage in /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx only mounts <ProductsTab/>, <OrdersTab/>, <CjTab/> - the <BlogTab/> and <MessagesTab/> components are defined at the bottom of the file but never mounted in the JSX. This blocks all admin blog CRUD/upload UI flows and the messages inbox UI (though the backend APIs work fine).

ui_bugs.issue: Tabs 'admin-tab-blog' and 'admin-tab-messages' are rendered in the tab bar, but the tab content is never mounted. Lines 61-63 only render products/orders/cj. Add `{tab === 'blog' && <BlogTab />}` and `{tab === 'messages' && <MessagesTab />}`. As a result blog-new-btn, blog-editor, admin-blog-row-*, admin-messages-tab, and admin-message-* are all inaccessible from the UI.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx after line 63, add: `{tab === 'blog' && <BlogTab />}` and `{tab === 'messages' && <MessagesTab />}` so the two new tabs actually render their content. Without this, none of the admin blog editor / upload / delete / messages inbox UI is reachable even though the backend endpoints work.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx (478 lines) is approaching split threshold; BlogTab/MessagesTab should be extracted into their own files under components/ or pages/admin/.
BlogTab.remove uses window.confirm('?') as the confirmation message - should use a proper i18n label.
MessagesTab uses api.get('/admin/contacts') and silently swallows errors (.catch(() => {})) - no error toast/state; consider surfacing failures.
Public GET /api/blog exposes ALL published posts (limit 500 hard-coded to 200) with no pagination - fine for now but plan cursor/limit params before scale.
Backend upload_image (server.py:304) does not enforce a maximum file size, allowing potentially huge uploads to /app/frontend/public/blog. Add a size cap.
server.py is 750 lines and should ideally be split into routers (blog, contact, products, orders, auth) for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None (3 blog posts already seeded by main agent; test-created blog post was deleted after test). One TEST_ contact message and one E2E_UI_TEST contact message left in db.contacts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_blog_contact.py are the regression suite for this feature - re-run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_blog_contact.py -v`. After main agent mounts <BlogTab/> and <MessagesTab/> in Admin.jsx, re-test the full admin flow: create post via Quill editor -> verify appears in public /blog -> edit -> delete; and verify Messages tab shows the contact submissions (E2E_UI_TEST subject is present in db).
rca of the issue: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx the tab buttons array (lines 43-49) was extended with 'blog' and 'messages' entries and the corresponding component functions BlogTab (line 379) and MessagesTab (line 447) were implemented, but the conditional render block (lines 61-63) was not extended, so setTab('blog') / setTab('messages') updates state but nothing is displayed under the tab bar. Fix: append `{tab === 'blog' && <BlogTab />}` and `{tab === 'messages' && <MessagesTab />}` after line 63. Reproduction: login as admin, go to /admin, click 'Blog' or 'Messages' - underline moves but the area below is empty.
